verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing says you can 'Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap' and have its AI surface answers, automate remediations and build reports. It also says you can 'Tell Rippling what you need' and agents will handle device ordering, routing and retrieval, and you can 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data.' A documented official MCP server further enables natural-language operation through external agents. These claims cover both querying and acting by natural language, but they come only from marketing pages. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of supported natural-language commands and their scope or limits, confirmation of how far natural-language actions extend across identity and device management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
